signature_moves: Breakfast-diner metaphor carried into the data layer — warm charcoal + burnt-orange + literal coffee cup reframes rate-limit dread as warmth; the opposite of pro-monochrome iStat/Bartender house style for the same job

Budget-as-headroom: 22% used shown in reassuring emerald green as the single saturated pixel-cluster in a dark chip (Von Restorff / signal-detection focus); meaning survives colorblindness because the % number is always present
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild) — pill label '5h window' #736D66 on #16110E ~3.9:1, under 4.5:1 normal-text floor
Non-native menu-bar glyph — color emoji as status glyph instead of a monochrome template SF Symbol (won't tint to menu bar; legibility risk at status size)
Custom status green off the system palette — #34D399 vs system Green #30D158
Brand/icon inconsistency — cover lockup uses the coffee emoji, shipped icon.png is a different custom orange-cup-with-token illustration
Evidence gap — marketing-cover-only submission yields no app-interior/window/lineage evidence

aesthetic.direction: warm indie-utility marketing — cream/amber ground + burnt-orange accent + warm-charcoal ink + bold grotesque display; a warm remix of neo-grotesque product rather than editorial serif or pro-monochrome
peers: Dato (menu-bar-utility peers, but warmer/friendlier than all of them)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal detection — the single saturated emerald '22%' in a dark chip is the one thing the eye lands on; exploited well
Loss framing (honest) — 'Ship before the limit hits' + rate-limit pressure is a real loss, not fabricated scarcity
Jakob's Law / glanceability — percentage-in-menu-bar reuses the learned battery-% convention; sub-second Doherty-threshold read
Aesthetic-usability effect — the polished warm composite raises the trust prior for an unknown no-cloud indie tool
Color-as-sole-signal risk (mitigated) — budget state leans on green vs presumably amber/red, but the always-present % number keeps meaning non-color-dependent
notes: MARKETING-COVER-ONLY digest: gallery/shots were empty; the only inputs were a 1200x630 OG marketing composite (cover.png) and the 1024 app icon (icon.png; icon is Workflow B, not digested here). The composite contains NO app window — the sole app-representative UI is one top-right status pill, likely a MenuBarExtra chip or popover-header render, unconfirmed. Therefore lineage=unknown/low and era=unknown, and this digest produces ZERO macOS-canon evidence — only brand palette + one chip pattern. Pill measurements are in composite-pixel space (marketing asset has no reliable retina scale) and are NOT converted to points. Contradiction to flag for synthesis: the cover's brand lockup mark (coffee emoji) disagrees with the shipped custom icon. To make this profile diagnostic, a real menu-bar dropdown and/or Settings screenshot is needed.
